body.message:
I will need a little time to prepare and share the contract with you. However, in the meantime, if you would like to secure the unit, we kindly request that you complete the security deposit payment so that we can block the unit for you.

Please note that we are unable to guarantee the availability until the payment is received, as the unit is currently listed on multiple booking platforms and we may receive another confirmed booking at any time.

Thank you for your understanding.
